title: cert-issuer/sign input
description: Input Contract for the cert-issuer/sign Action (ADR-0050, CERT-2): submit a TARGET-GENERATED CSR to the CLM and return the signed certificate. This is the born-on-target half of certificate delivery — the private key is generated on the host, never leaves it, and only the CSR (public) crosses the wire (§2.5). `csr` is bound from the gather Step's typed output ({{.steps.<name>.outputs.csr}}), which is why this is an ACTION rather than an Actuator verb: an Action's result binds into a later Step, and the delivery Step needs the signed certificate. Neutrally named — a step-ca implementation of the certissuer capability satisfies this same document (§1.5).

csr.description: The target's PEM certificate-signing request. Public material by construction; the key that produced it stays on the host.

role.description: The CLM role to sign under, from Intent/Certificate's `issuer`. A role name and never a provider path, so the same Intent survives a CLM swap.

ttl.description: Requested validity, from the Intent's `validity`. The CLM's role policy is the ceiling — a request above it is the CLM's to refuse, not ours to pre-check.
